title: Single Canonical Route Registry
rationale: Prevent route sprawl, serve as single source of truth

title: Entity Resolution over Slug Synthesis
decision: Dynamic routes only resolve to real entities; unknown slugs 404

title: True SSR with Hydration
decision: Render initial HTML into #root div; client hydrates

title: Evidence-Backed Content Lifecycle
decision: Implement EvidenceClaim, quality gates, state machine

title: Redirect Single-Hop Guarantee
decision: All redirects must be one hop; verified by tests

title: Automated Verification Suite
decision: Create verify-* scripts; all must pass before release

title: SEO by Default
decision: Implement canonicals, unique titles/descriptions, JSON-LD, sitemaps
rationale: Rank well in SERPs and AI Overviews

title: Health and Rate Limiting
decision: Add /health endpoint; limit API to 60 req/min
rationale: Ops readiness and basic abuse resistance

title: Documentation as Code
decision: Keep all docs version-controlled in docs/
